title: Folic Acid: Drug Usage Statistics, United States, 2014 - 2024
journal: ClinCalc DrugStats Database, version 2026.08, ClinCalc LLC
population: US prescriptions estimated from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) 2014 to 2024 of the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
result: Top drug rank 95 in 2024 (94 in 2023); estimated 7,503,346 prescriptions and 1,899,433 patients in the United States in 2024; 96.2% of dispensed products were 1 mg tablets or capsules. Rank is defined as the frequency of prescription within a calendar year compared with all other medications. Page updated 9 August 2026.
